tree._note: The upgrade tree's rings and pacing bars (ROADMAP E, R 16.1, R 1.1/1.4, b2-28). Every node of a species listed under species carries a ring (1 = the centre) and a kind: stat (a number goes up), verb (changes what the player does or sees), stage (an evolution). rings: in order from the centre, the growth stage each opens at and the node count it is meant to reach (about 14 / 16 / 18 / 10; D-135 cut the fourth body, so ring 4 is the adult's last climb). A ring is open (bought and shown in full) once the kaiju has reached its stage and owns a node of the ring before it; the next ring shows as shapes; evolutions always show. cost_rate: each level of a node costs this many times the level before (geometric, research 01 rec 1). pacing: the bars tools/pacing.gd and the tree suite check over the first window_hours of play (R 1.1): buys_per_visit after every rampage, at most max_runs_between_verbs runs between a new verb or stage, each evolution within evolve_tolerance of its target hour (evolve1 about 15 min, D-087; evolve2 about 1 h, research 16 rec 1), the first purchase within first_buy_seconds. income: the tree suite's stand-in for a rampage's pay at each stage (first -> last as that stage's levels are bought; run_seconds a rampage), from GitHub pacing run 40225039778 (main after #230); the real bot (tools/pacing.gd) measures it. Effect keys with no system yet (stat_text hides them): eat_heal (eating heals).

Each ring's radius leaves every node in it node_gap of room on the circle and clears the ring inside by ring_gap; ring 1 sits at least centre_radius out.

fire._doc: Fire spread (D-126, sim/fire_spread.gd). A burning building heats each neighbour within reach m of its footprint (plus ember_reach m per Ember Rain level) by heat_rate a second at a touching wall, less with the gap, x (1 + fire_rate) x (1 + fire_wind x downwind) x flammability by building style; heat cools at cool_rate a second with no fire near. At heat 1 it glows glow_seconds, then burns burn_seconds + burn_per_floor x floors and burns out: its lowest burn_out_floors floors take burn_out_damage a chunk over burn_out_seconds in burn_out_steps batches, the downwind side first, and the rest drops and topples like a smashed building (D-129); what it drops pays burn_pay of a smash x the conflagration (+conflag_step a burn-out, to conflag_max, decaying conflag_decay a second; conflag_max keeps a burn-out near 60% of a smash, never more, D-126), x far_pay past far_radius m from the kaiju. Ignition (D-129): the beam's burning coat always, each building the breath reaches with chance breath_ignite, a stray army shell within shell_reach m with chance shell_ignite. grid: the footprint index cell, m; the heat pass runs every spread_tick s; view_size: the size of each fire the view puts on a burning building's roof, one per roof quarter on a roof at least view_spacing m across (else one); view_out_fade: seconds a fire on a breaking or falling chunk takes to dim out. Firestorm blasts grow firestorm_grow a level past the first. PLACEHOLDERS flagged for tuning (D-129): every number here and the five nodes' places and costs in data/upgrades.json (r_ablaze .. r_firestorm).

momentum._note: D-337 the titan's run (sim/momentum.gd; director 2026-10-27: 'momentum based, at high momentum he can crash right through smaller buildings, and collide with a bang into bigger ones'; always on). Momentum 0..1 builds while he walks, to full in build_seconds (the momentum node builds it faster: build_seconds / (1 + its stat x node_build)), bleeds turn_bleed per radian turned and idle_decay a second standing, and speeds his walk by speed_bonus x momentum. At crash_min he crashes through every building column standing under his crash height (crash_height 'shoulder': shoulder by stage, or 'body': his body's top, the contact discs) without slowing or spending it; at slam_min (slams true) his first touch of anything at or over it is one slam: strength = momentum x hit, a dent of dent_radius x body scale x strength across the ground on the floors he touched, momentum 0, the body stopped where it was. shoulder: world units at body scale 1 by stage, the arm_l0 joint's height over the rig's height x 10 in assets/kaiju/reptilian_<stage>.rig.json (young 123.38/200, Behemoth 186.48/260, Colossus 208.77/320). titans: by creation.titans id; a species with no entry has no momentum.

heli_wreck._note: How a downed helicopter looks (HeliWreck, HeliFx, HeliDebris; D-140/D-141/D-145), judged at the game camera (about 18 px per metre at 1080p). Kill (burst): a flare of flare_size m for flare_seconds, a light of burst_light for burst_light_seconds, a ball of fireball_tongues smooth flame tongues (fireball_tongue x the street tongue, graded over fireball_flame_h m) thrown fireball_speed_min..max m/s and climbing with fireball_rise m/s2 (blooms for fireball_seconds, fireball_radius m), a puff of smoke_puffs smoke quads smoke_size m for smoke_seconds (young smoke tinted smoke_warm then smoke_mid), Fire burst_fire for burst_seconds, the model's parts thrown throw_min..max m/s sideways and up to up_max (the body and tail rotor trailing a Fire of part_fire), plus burst_shards chunks (burst_burning of them burning at shard_fire). Spin: hit_flare, hit_light, hit_smoke; three Fires of trail_fire spaced trail_offset m along the hull (a flame body), a dark smoke trail of trail_puffs puffs trail_smoke_size m for trail_smoke_seconds (tinted trail_warm and trail_mid, trail_self_lit glow); its path bows swing m sideways; spins at spin rad/s, pitches pitch_deg and rolls roll_deg by the landing; crew chutes fall at chute_speed m/s under a canopy canopy_width m wide hung canopy_hang m above them (canopy_glow emission). Crash: crash_flare, crash_light for crash_light_seconds, a crash_fireball-scaled fireball and crash_smoke-scaled puff, a ground Fire of crash_fire left burning, dust of crash_scale and a street-dust ring crash_ring times that, crash_shards chunks, the rotors thrown and the body left lying. Chunks fall at gravity m/s2, lie rest_seconds, then shrink away over fade_seconds.

strike._note: Damage lands on impact (D-166, D-175; Strikes): the reptilian's big attacks wreck when the jaws or the foot land, a beat after the press, not on it. breath = seconds from the press to the strike by size tier (young, Behemoth, Colossus); the cone is read at the strike, from where he faces then. beam = seconds from the press to the Thunder Beam stream (the walk slow, powers.beam_move_mult, starts at the press). stomp_standing = seconds from a stomp tick to its damage when he stands still (a walking stomp lands on its tick; the view syncs it to the footfall). Cooldowns count from the press. Nothing lands if the rampage ends or the size tier changes first. The dash is instant (the crouch is view-only, D-165). The events carry the time: strike_windup (kind, strike_in) at the press for the breath and the beam, strike_in on the stomp event.

air._note_flight: How a helicopter flies (D-183 Stand-off gunships, AirFlight). Distances marked (x scale) are in model units times the kaiju's body scale, so they grow with him: a claw rake reaches 13 x scale ahead (powers.swipe_far) and its band is up to about 4.6 x scale wide, the breath reaches 25 x scale or more. Each helicopter steers for its slot: a point on its own ring round the kaiju that goes where he goes (standoff = the ring (x scale), standoff_jitter = how far each one's own ring differs, spawn_far = rings out it flies in from). heli_speed (units a second), heli_accel (units a second squared) and heli_turn_deg (degrees a second, its nose) are its limits, so it glides and backs off without a jerk; its nose follows its flight from nose_share of top speed up and faces the kaiju below it; arrive = how close to its goal counts as there (it hovers facing him). The pilots take the kaiju to be where he was over the last anchor_seconds (his stepped turns swing his position ten units or more about the planted foot, which they do not chase) and put each slot lead_seconds of his walk ahead, so a helicopter backs off before he is on it. pull_back = the kaiju within this (x scale) of it puts its slot straight behind it (under standoff x (1 - standoff_jitter)). hold_seconds = how long it keeps a slot, glide_deg = how far along the ring it moves to the next, slot_tries = candidate slots tried for room from the others. clear_arc (and clear_lead_deg more, for lag) = the camera side no slot enters. Strafing: one pass at a time, strafe_gap seconds apart (strafe_retry later when no helicopter slot is within strafe_reach_deg of the line entry), a fly-by at full speed along a straight line that passes strafe_close (x scale) from the kaiju on the flank (the camera's view along him) on the side of the helicopter's slot, turned on until it keeps clear of the corridor of pass_corridor (x scale) each side of the camera's line to him, so it never flies between the camera and him, aimed strafe_lead seconds of his walk ahead, lined up first (it flies to the line's entry end and hovers there, as at a slot) and then run by following a point strafe_carrot (x scale) ahead along it, the line bending outward past him by strafe_veer (so it turns away from the corridor), over strafe_exit (x scale) past him, where it turns back out to its slot (strafe_seconds the longest). Placeholders, flagged for tuning.

vip._note: The leader's escape helicopter (VipHeli, D-149, director 2026-10-25 'go'): once a rampage, at a seeded moment (window = share of the run), the city's leader (ranks by size tier: Mayor, Governor, President) lifts off a standing mid-rise (pad_height floors, pad_range m from the kaiju, else any) and climbs over climb_seconds while it flies one banked lap of circle_radius (x body scale) in circle_seconds (setting off sideways so the circle curls away from the kaiju, lap_jitter_deg of seeded wobble), then runs for the map edge away from the kaiju (exit_spread_deg either side, no faster than turn_limit rad/s, gathering speed at accel) so the flight lasts about window_seconds (escape_cap x window_seconds is the longest it may fly); it escapes at exit_margin past the arena edge. payout[tier] = about one city block's worth of biomass (a block's mean in-arena building value, measured by tests/run_vip_tests.gd per city size; a kill pays it x the kaiju's rubble_mult, an escape pays nothing and loses only that). hp = the air wing's hp x hp_mult; radius = hit radius; throw_pass / throw_ceiling = how close a thrown tank or car must fly, and how low the leader must be, to bring it down. rotor_pitch / rotor_db: its own rotor sound (the cleared heli_rotor.ogg, lower and louder). Headlines go to the news strip ({rank} is the rank): liftoff, killed, escaped (mocking), shown headline_seconds. gold / white = the VIP look (white body, gold rotors and trim). bank / pitch = radians the model leans a turn rad/s and a ground speed unit; turn = how quickly its heading follows the sim's (as heli_turn); rotor_unit = the rotor sound's reach (a 3D unit size). Placeholders flagged for tuning.

taskforce._note: The Anti Kaiju Taskforce, agents only (Taskforce, TaskforceFrost, TaskforceVolley; D-137, D-139, D-141, D-143, D-145). PLACEHOLDER NUMBERS (tune) except the director's: railgun.share 0.08 of max health (D-143), railgun.aim_seconds 2.0 (D-139), railgun.cooldown 12 s per agent, frost.slow_mult 0.5 for frost.seconds 4 s, a kill pays a tank's worth (rubble_share 1.0 of army.tank_rubble) (D-152), squads of 3-4 and max 12 alive (D-139), none in the young city (D-137, D-152). max_by_tier = most alive at once per size tier (young, adolescent, ...). The Taskforce joins every rampage once first_arrival.city_seconds of rampage time are carried in from earlier rampages in the adolescent city or later (D-160, the save keeps the counter), its first squad first_arrival.run_delay seconds in, then every start_interval seconds less escalation_per_chunk x chunks destroyed (never under min_interval): faster the more of the city falls (D-145). Agents jetpack in from a ring edge_inset past the arena at jet_speed (units a second) and cruise jet_height up, then perch on the highest standing chunk of a column of a building at least perch_min_height tall, perch_range [near, far] from the kaiju, trying perch_tries chunks (with no building in the band, one of the perch_fallback nearest to it); a perched agent hops on after perch_seconds [min, max] (hop speed = jet_speed x hop_speed_share, arcing hop_arc up). rubble_share = biomass per kill as a share of this city's tank_rubble (x the kaiju's rubble_mult). hover_seconds = how long an agent with no roof to go to hovers before looking again, min_flight_s = the shortest flight. first_charge = the share of a cooldown a fresh agent has already waited. railgun: armour (stat armor) is taken off a hit as for a tank shell, never below army.min_damage; the line tracks the kaiju for aim_seconds - lock_seconds, then locks and lands on the lock; lock_seconds per growth stage (lock_seconds_by_stage, baby/adolescent/adult; director 2026-10-26 "Longer warning, scaled by size": a leap pressed at the lock, crouch included, clears the whole volley; was 0.4; D-402 grown 1.0 / 1.3 so a step eased in over walk_off_s still clears the lock); it hits for share x max health only if the kaiju is within hit_radius of the lock (a late step dodges it); cooldown, range, hop_after (seconds before it hops on), squad_gap (D-166, D-178 Lock together, fire in turn: a squad's ready gunners put their lines up together and the lines lock at the same moment on one point, aim_seconds - lock_seconds after; the shots then land that many seconds apart, the first aim_seconds after the lines go up; over 0.5 so one squad never lands more than 2 hits in a second, and one leap at the lock leaves the kaiju clear of the whole volley; 0.6 is the pick inside about 2 hits' worth in a second). frost: cooldown per agent, range, flight_s grenade flight, radius (1.5) it must land within (the kaiju's feet: walking dodges, standing still is caught, D-161), seconds of slow, slow_mult speed multiplier; The cloud: seconds 8 and about one street wide (D-152), streets = its width in the city's street widths; while the kaiju stands in it his specials (signature, ultimate, a running Thunder Beam) are locked, the dash and physical attacks are not, and it does no damage (D-145); hold = how far from ready it keeps the specials each step. convoy._band_depth: How far past the body's keep-away (body_radius + edge_gap + the hull's half diagonal) the tanks' firing band always reaches, in units: their reach is at least (keep-away + band_depth) / band[1], so a small kaiju (the young croc) is never out of every firing post (Convoy.reach).
convoy._retreat_clear: Metres past the danger line a falling-back tank keeps retreat_speed before slowing to its reverse speed, so a kaiju following it never pins it astride the line in a fast-slow stutter.
convoy._yield_cap: A tank giving way yields at most stuck x yield_cap seconds in one stretch, however long the tank it makes way for stays held up; then it re-plans (TankSpacing.yield_limit).

flight._note: Tanks the reptilian sends flying (sim/tank_flight.gd; research 22 recs 2-4; director 2026-10-30 'Flight first, same PR' for Ricochet and Domino; numbers agent-set). The ram and the leap launch a tank at loft_deg so it lands on open ground where the old shove put it (no flight under min_distance). gravity in units/s2. A building column above the hull (+ clearance) is a wall: it carves wall_floors floors from the impact height, wall_damage x the tank's ground speed, falling off past wall_radius, and the tank drops there. bounces: free bounces before Ricochet (throw_ricochet adds one per level), off a wall at wall_restitution or off the ground (falling faster than min_bounce_speed) at ground_restitution, losing ground_friction of its forward speed. Domino (throw_domino = chain depth): a flying tank within strike_radius of a grounded one deals domino_damage and launches it domino_reach on along its way. Tumble (director 2026-10-30 'Seeded mix', 'Lands as it falls'): each launch spins the hull about a seeded axis, spin_turns_min..max turns over the flight; a landing within topple_deg of upright drops onto its tracks, past it the tank rests on its side or roof (toppled: never drives or fires again, not counted by endless's max_tanks).

blast_fx._note: How the red barrels look and sound going off (BlastFx, BlastParts; director comments #19, #20). Sizes scale with the sim's blast radius (explosives.*.radius). shake.trauma: how hard each kind of blast kicks the camera (times 1 - distance/reach from the kaiju); kick = ONE kick of units x that, thrown up and away from the blast and easing out (squared) over kick.seconds, never a shake back and forth (clip critic round 6); no screen flash (director 2026-10-27: cut), no hit-stop and no screen-bending ripple any more. sound.speed: the speed of sound in map units/s (343 m/s at about 3.5 m a unit, one floor); the sonic boom plays that late, from boom_from units away, never later than boom_max_delay; every blast cracks once, crack_db over the mix with no distance fade (round 7: the third blast's crack barely cleared the bed), body and rumble sit tail_db under it. flash.max_live: real lights at once (LightPool keeps lights.pool_size for lamps and fires). Motion critic fix round 2026-10-21: core = white-hot voxels out of the site box for core.seconds (a few frames), thrown core.throw radii; fireball.top_scale x reach_scale = how far the ball reaches (round 2, 7), speed_scale = start speed in radii/s (round 6: 2-3x the footprint), build_seconds = it spawns over that long (a few frames, not one), fireball = a sudden tall burst of Fire's own flames (Fire.FLAME_CUBE voxels at Fire.FLAME_SCALE, its ember shader at its own heat, its colours and ramp: a bigger blast is more flames, never bigger cubes): amount of them at blast radius 5, spawned over burst_seconds, living seconds, up on a spread (degrees) with gravity lift up like Fire's, speed_scale radii a second, damped to stop top_scale site heights up; fire = the real Fire left at the site afterwards (size x radius/5; seconds 0: it stays burning like any other until the fire cap puts the oldest out) which brings the game's own smoke (D-151, VFX lead 2026-10-23); shock.ring = the game's dust shockwave out to the blast's reach plus puffs Fx.dust round its rim; cloud = the chem gas as the game's soft smoke tinted shades, puff = its size range, shock.ring = small pale dust cubes (round 3: opaque lit voxels, no smooth parts) running out on a thin ring to max(footprint_scale x the site's widest side / 2, 2 x blast radius) in ring.seconds; break = how a site the blast reaches lets go: slices steps a frame each, top first, pieces thrown push out and up; cloud = green cubes in shades, a burst of amount then boil_amount boiling for the sim's cloud seconds, in size_scale x the lab box (at least cloud_share x the sim cloud radius wide), each living billow_seconds; stream_view._note: BuildingStream spends the stream_chunks budget on what the camera sees, not on a circle round the kaiju: a building ranks by its distance from the camera, or from the kaiju plus kaiju_extra_m, whichever is less; one that lies only in the margin band (margin_deg wide, each side of the frustum) ranks side_m farther, one outside that outside_m farther; a ring of ring_m round the camera has no penalty. margin_deg covers the camera's shake (camera_shake max_deg 2.5, a test checks it) and a quick turn, so a turn meets buildings the plan has already meshed (the breath's side orbit was cut, D-136). A landmark stays meshed while the frustum or the margin band reaches it or it stands within landmark_keep_m of the camera or the kaiju (a test checks no landmark is ever a box in view); beyond all three it unloads like any building (director 2026-10-22: out-of-view landmarks may unload if no pop-in). Every building within hold_m of the kaiju is held meshed outside the budget, so a blow (a toppled tower lands up to ~55 m away at the adult) never waits on an on-the-spot build (D-256 frame bar). When a tower starts to topple, every building within fall_margin_m of its landing strip (the line from its pivot to its far end, reaching fall_margin_m further) is meshed at once, outside the budget, before it lands.

road_paint._note: Road paint by real marking logic (director 2026-10-28 18:2x: 'a lot of roads are lacking roadpaint, all roads must have road lines when appropriate, must make logical sense and be realistic'; D-248, D-054), RoadPaint, presentation only, on every road the plan lays (no reach limit). A road at least two_lane_min wide (m; alleys are narrower, so none) gets a centre line: dashes (dash_length long every dash_pitch, line_width wide) below double_min wide, a double solid line (double_gap apart) from it up; roads at least 2 x lane_width x 2 wide have more than one lane each way: lane dashes between the lanes and solid edge lines edge_inset in from each kerb. Paint stops dash_clear short of a crossing road's asphalt (solid lines sampled every solid_step). A stop line (stop_width deep, stop_gap short of the junction box, stop_inset off the centre line) crosses the right-hand lane where a road meets a road square to it. Zebras stay at the central junction only (zebra_junctions).

landmarks._note: The landmark pool (D-375): an entry with a "size" (medium, big, biggest) is drawn each run into a designated spot of that size (city.landmark_spots, CitySpread.spot_draws); "spot" names the only spot it may take (stadium west, wheel east). An entry with no size (the bridge) is spread by map_seed.

landmark_spots._note: Designated landmark spots (D-375, D-380): fixed on every street plan, the landmark in each drawn per run from the pool entries of its size (medium near the beach, big the next ring, biggest the outer ring: each stage reaches something bigger); at = [x, z], or the nearest cell of its district that fits. A spot no entry is left for stays plain city. west and east: off every stage's sea bay (CityHarbour), south past the river row, inside stage 2's reach (D-271); stage 1 shows the east one only (D-380; tests/lib/city_stadium_far.gd). big and biggest: district 2 (stage 3), south off the bay; the city has no ring past it yet, so both share it (biggest east of the spire, in the band stage 2 shows past its edge).

spread._note: CitySpread (D-254): landmarks spread by map_seed. landmarks_per_ring = most landmarks a district takes; a landmark's min_ring = the first district it may stand in (the stadium, the wheel and the bridge never in the young city: b2-21, D-270 'South, past the river', the river), max_ring the last (the stadium reachable from stage 2: D-271 'The stage-2 stadium bar stands'); place_order = the order landmarks place in, lowest first, none after every ordered one (the most constrained first: the stadium, then the bridge, which only the river's far bank takes); far_from_rise = it takes the fitting cell of its district farthest from the kaiju's rise (the stadium: b2-21 'as far away from our spawn spot as possible'); landmark_gap = share of a stage's play-area width that the landmarks it newly opens keep apart (a pair with an inner district's site keeps the inner stage's share: lead call 2026-10-26); spawn_clear = share of the width kept off the kaiju's rise (a landmark's own rise_clear m when more: the stadium, b2-21; rise_slack m covers the rise's exact spot); bridge_rows = rows of blocks the bridge's inlet takes past the river

harbour._note: The fixed beachfront every run rises from (CityHarbour; D-381, board v4 approved by the director 2026-10-29: "build this as a bespoke, fixed location, its always the same, just have the randomzied map connect to these fixed roads"): everything north of the back street, the same at every stage; the random street grid meets it on the back street, its one pinned z-line. beach_x: the beach's west and east ends (x; past the west end it runs on unchanged); the seawall stands east of it, then the port runs on east. sea_z: the board's open-sea line (z). shore: the waterline, z = sea_z + [0] + [1] x sin(pi u)^[2] + [3] x u, u 0 at the beach's east end to 1 at its west end. sand, promenade: band widths at the east and west ends (lerped by u). road: the beach road's width, on past the port. back_z: the back street (z). side_streets: [first x, spacing] west from it, square off the beach road to the back street. quay_back: the port's quay edge, this far seaward of the road. piers: [east x, width, length] out from the quay. seawall: rects [x, z, w, d], the rubble mound and its hook north over the port's mouth; light: its head (x, z). arc_points: the shore's polyline samples. beach: metres from the waterline to the foot of the sand slope; sand_top: the beach's top under the street; sea_level: the water's surface (CityGround's sea); seabed_depth: metres from the surface to the floor at the rise, fitted as crouch_back (per body scale: the tallest stage's rise_bay crouch at its first frame, the Behemoth's back top 5.67, keyer 2026-10-28) x the stage's biggest body scale + seabed_clear; rise_x: where on the shore he rises; nose_gap: metres between the nose and the beach's foot at the rise; bank_inset: metres past the waterline he wades to; fit_margin: metres added to the body's width (fit_width); view_clear (fitted) and view_margin: no painted stand-in in camera reach of the rise.

city_sound._doc: CitySound (D-155, panic then eerie quiet): one driver sets every city bed from the rampage's phase, 0 at the first stomp to 1 when the city is ruined. phase = destruction_weight of (destruction share / destruction_full) plus the rest of (people fled / population / fled_full), each capped at 1. curve: [phase, dB] keys, linear between; crowd is a trim on the crowd loop's own panic level (0 = untouched), every other bed is its level in dB. Panic (crowd, sirens) peaks early and is gone by the end; gunfire, fire and wind carry the ruined city.

music._doc: MusicLayers (D-125; briefs in docs/audio/music-briefs.md): one track per city (size tier 1..3: baby, adolescent, adult), cut by tools/music/cut_loops.py into 4 layers that fade in, in this order, on the same phase as the city beds (D-189 "low and creeping": low strings and bass alone at first, drums at the first big collapses, brass and the full theme at the peak), on one locked tempo (AudioStreamSynchronized). bpm is the take's measured tempo and bars its loop length in bars (the tool prints both); every stem file must be exactly bars * beats_per_bar * 60 / bpm seconds long (lock_tolerance_s) or the loader warns. A stem whose file is missing plays as silence of that length. enter/full: the phases a stem starts and finishes fading in.

rail._note: The elevated railway (Rail; the director 2026-10-21 #63 "train stations + tracks with trains on them", #69 "Derail and smash"; 2026-10-25 "research train locomotion and derailment physics", the 022 result). A two-track viaduct up the north-south avenue nearest the middle, deck_y up, deck_width wide, tracks track_gap apart, from span[0] to span[1] x the city's half extent along z (crossing the river), its station at station_share of the way. Trains of cars (the first a locomotive), car_length long, coupler_gap apart, at most max_trains running, one every headway_s (the first after first_s), entering at enter_share of cruise, speeding up at accel, braking at brake (emergency for broken track), dwelling dwell_s. Scaled from metro practice (1.0 m/s2 accel and brake, 1.3 emergency) to the city's scale. The viaduct and station are voxel structures (structure): they carve and fall like buildings, and the track is broken wherever its deck is gone. A hit of derail_damage or more on a car (car_radius) derails its train: the hit car kicked sideways at kick, the rest folding alternately (yaw_rate, roll_rate), sliding with friction (a share of g; post-derailment estimates 0.4-0.6), spin_damp, a car off the deck falling and keeping land_keep of its speed on landing, a car within pile_share of a length of the one ahead sharing its speed. A train behind stops stop_short before it, or derails if it reaches it above crash_speed. The kaiju's body derails a train when it reaches the deck (body_share of its stomp radius). Each car pays rubble_share of army.tank_rubble (the vehicle rule) and a derailment derail_bonus once on top (the director, 022 update: a big one-off bonus, well above a car; he judges it in playtest). PLACEHOLDER NUMBERS (tune).

structure._note: The viaduct and station as voxel structures in the city's buildings (RailLayout, D-247; the director 2026-10-26 "carve is a universal feature for all buildings"): pieces of piece_bays bays, column bents every bay_length; sizes in sim units: slab thick, parapet high and wide, column square, column_inset from the deck edge, cap under the deck, ballast_half and rail_offset round each track, sleeper_every and seam_every along it; the station's platform wide, canopy over the deck, post_every along it, stair wide. They carve, fall and pay like any building (tier).

bridge._note: The river bridges as voxel structures (BridgeLayout, D-389; the director 2026-10-30: carve is universal, "Carve, spans drop" and "Keep deck, add piers"). Each CityRiver.bridges deck is cut along the river into pieces about span long, each a building in the city's list: an asphalt deck slab thick with its top at street level, a stone parapet [high, wide] along each side, and a stone pier wall pier thick at each piece boundary (half on each piece), abutment thick at each bank, down to the riverbed bed floors under the street (whole floors, so its chunks meet the street's; the water is city.river_depth down). A deck stretch cut off its piers topples or drops into the river like any carved part. They carve, fall and pay like any building (tier). PLACEHOLDER NUMBERS (tune).

rail_look._note: The railway's look (TrainModel, RailView): car_size (width, height in units) of a metro car; colours: the cars, and the viaduct and station (RailVoxels draws the rail structure materials with them); sounds: rumble_db and slide_db at full, the rumble heard within hear_range of the kaiju, the horn when the kaiju comes within horn_range of a running train, again every horn_every seconds (one-shots heard in 3D, unit_size) (it keeps running, the horn blares); survivors_per_car people crawl out of each wrecked car crawl_s after the derailment and flee. creation._note: D-207 Kaiju Creation, the new-game opening: a lab close-up on a petri dish and a rack of genomes; pick a genome, inject Special K (the kaiju juice, named by the director 2026-10-25), the kaiju genome takes over, the camera rushes into black with an egg crack, then the first run's river rise. titans: the rack in order; species is the species.json id a genome plays ("" = no titan to play yet); unlocked is the state a new player starts with, and a save's titans_unlocked list (save_key) unlocks more (the unlock rules are not decided, D-207). timing in seconds (ticks at 60 a second). Lab sizes in metres, one voxel size for the whole set; colours are PLACEHOLDERS for the VFX lead (juice: the kaiju's white-hot, pending R 17.6; behind the takeover's front the cells cool to the species' body colour, veins of them still burning). crack_sound names assets/sfx/<name>.ogg (made on ElevenLabs 2026-10-25 in the director's lab-sound list); with no file the cue is silent.

glass._note: the glass petri dish standing on the agar (cells): a ring inner..outer from the dish axis, height cells tall, its top row the bright rim; the lightning stays inside it; glint: the arc (degrees round the axis, x towards z) where the rim catches the key lamp in pure white; the agar steps in three tones from its middle to a darker ring at the glass (pixel-art glass and liquid: a dark desaturated body, a white highlight, a liquid brighter in the middle and darker at the walls)

injector._note: the director 2026-10-25: "injector rotates to the croc vial, drains it, moves to dish and puts croc gene into dish", then the same from the Special K canister; "Use image A whole". A hit away from the focus fades from near_per_scale to far_per_scale body scales. default_motion: the camera-motion setting's default (0..1).

accessibility._note: Settings > ACCESSIBILITY (D-259). flash_scale: while Reduce flashing is on, every flash of light (explosion, muzzle and breath lights, flares, the end beat's screen flash, the lab's lightning white) is drawn at this share of its brightness, and the colour fringe never shows.

photo_mode._note: PhotoMode (D-259 'Photo mode: Yes, simple'): from the pause menu the world stays frozen and a free camera flies round the kaiju. radius_rest_multiple: how far from the kaiju's feet the camera may go, in multiples of the gameplay camera's distance at this body size (so it grows with the kaiju); min_height: the camera never sinks below this many world units over the ground (y 0); speed_rest_multiple: flying speed, those distances a second; look_deg_per_s: right-stick turn rate; mouse_deg_per_px: mouse turn per pixel moved; pitch_limit_deg: how far up or down the camera can tilt.

rumble._note: PadRumble (D-259 'Yes, scaled by size, with a toggle'): pad vibration, weak (high-frequency) and strong (low-frequency) motors 0..1 for seconds. footfall and stomp: one row per growth stage (baby, adolescent, adult), so the thud grows with the kaiju; collapse: a toppled building landing; breath: the buzz while the breath burns (its seconds) and, for the ultimate beam, for the beam's own seconds. Settings > ACCESSIBILITY > Rumble turns it off.

post_fx._note: PostFx (D-142, director 2026-10-22), presentation only, every graphics preset. Vignette: the screen edges darken (smoothstep from inner to outer of the corner distance, 0 = centre, 1 = corner) to alpha strength in color, always the same dark edge: low health is the HUD's heartbeat vignette alone (ui.hurt; director 2026-10-27: vignette only), with no red band here. The colour fringe (red and blue split apart toward the screen edges, px at 1080 lines) lasts seconds, peaks at attack of that time, and fires only on a top-tier impact: a stomp of radius stomp_min_radius or more (world units, a full-quake Behemoth up), a toppling part collapse_min_length or more long, or a single step costing the kaiju hit_hp_fraction of its max health; never twice within cooldown_s. The camera-motion setting scales the fringe.

skyline_rampage._note: Director 2026-10-25 'yes bring it back': a far insectoid rampaging through the skyline across the bay, on by default. Presentation only (SkylineRampage).

tail._note: TailTouch (director 2026-10-30: the tail carves whatever it touches): body discs with offset <= from are the tail; each widened by pad (design units) to the drawn tail and its spring sway; the tail lies along a heading that follows the body's at follow /s, so a turn swings it wide.

contact._note: bodies[species][stage].stomp_foot = [ahead, across] at body scale 1: where a stomp's foot comes down against kaiju_pos (design units ahead along the heading, and out to the left foot; the right foot mirrors it). The sim's stomp damages around that point (RampageSim._stomp), the point the drawn ring lands on (measured with tools/capture/probe_stomp_foot.gd). No entry: the stomp is centred on kaiju_pos.
contact._note_turn_ramp: D-187: a stepped (Behemoth, Colossus) U-turn speeds its yaw up over this share of its uturn_s, runs even between, and slows over the same share at the end; so the peak yaw rate is 1 / (1 - turn_ramp) of the turn's mean rate (1.18 at 0.15; the bar is 1.3). A smaller share is a snappier start and stop, a larger one a gentler, peakier turn.
contact._note_turn_land_deg: D-187: a U-turn counts as made when the body is within this many degrees of the new way (the motion critic's measure); the last degrees take a little longer.
contact._note_walk_off_s: D-355, per growth step in bodies.reptilian, optional (else the contact walk_off_s 0.134): seconds a set-off from a stand takes to reach full stride, rising evenly. The grown croc (Behemoth, Colossus) eases in over about 1.3 s; the keyed walk-start plays over it.
contact._note_uturn_s: D-187, per growth step in bodies.reptilian: seconds a stick-reversed U-turn takes while walking, until within turn_land_deg of the new way (Behemoth 1.94, Colossus 3.0; the young croc has none: it turns smoothly, D-131). The director's pick is Behemoth 2 s, Colossus 3 s (D-187); the Behemoth runs 1.94 by the lead's ruling 2026-10-27 (1.9, then 1.94 by the sweep below) because the motion gate's centre_max 0.5 (D-177, the body turns about its middle, not a planted foot) needs a peak yaw of at least ~99 deg/s. Sweep, 60 Hz motion drive, centre travel on turn90 / turn180 / stand_turn: uturn_s 2.0 0.506 / 0.340 / 0.472 (turn90 misses by 0.006); 1.94 0.481 / 0.340 / 0.459 (every motion bar met); 1.9 0.481 / 0.330 / 0.459; 1.8 0.450 / 0.314 / 0.420 (stand_turn pivot 0.087 over its 0.08 bar); 1.2 0.281 / 0.210 / 0.321 (stand_turn pivot 0.326 and aloft yaw 1.30 fail). The bots in the sim and city suites chase the nearest chunk and can circle it with a heavy turn, so their results jump with uturn_s: 1.94 is the value near 2 where the motion gate, the rise-point bar (every map seed down within 10 s: 2.8 / 4.0 / 8.9 s) and the sim suite (evolved 0.788 vs 0.520) all pass; 1.9 fails the rise bar on seed 1234 (23.5 s) and the sim check (0.058). Colossus at 3.0 passes unchanged. Any other angle turns at the same peak rate and ramps.
contact._note_turn_slow: D-187, per growth step in bodies.reptilian, optional (else the contact turn_slow 0.5): the share of full stride the body keeps at an about-face. A stepped body turns on the spot nearly: while the stride runs on, the walk and the pivot about the planted foot cancel on one foot (it shuffles) and add on the other, and the rotation centre drifts off the feet.
contact._note_turn_steps: D-187, per growth step in bodies.reptilian: footfalls a U-turn is made in, so a turn steps at turn_steps / uturn_s footfalls a second (Behemoth 2.84, Colossus 1.83, against the straight walk's 2.14 and 1.75), 33 degrees of yaw a step on average, 39 at the peak (the motion critic's bar is at most 40). Fewer would put more yaw in a step, more would shuffle the feet: a foot moves less than a third of its length in a step.

leap._note: The dash button's leap (Dash, D-259 "a leap that lands on a building and crushes it with a shockwave (replaces the dash)"). Per species and stage (baby, adolescent, adult): reach / min_reach = how far the feet may land from where they stand (design units at body scale 1): the nearest standing building whose centre is in that band and within aim_half_angle_deg of the facing, else the full reach; a target that dwarfs the body (D-091), or a roof landing that would put the body inside such a building, is landed before instead: on the street, backed off along the flight line in landing_step units until clear. crouch_s (crouch and push), flight_s (airborne), settle_s (impact settle), recover_s (to walk-ready) are the reader's L1 frames at 30 fps (C:/kt/croc_kit/reference.md: 14+15+15+18 / 18+21+21+25 / 24+26+26+32); the body takes no stick through all four. The flight is a high arc onto the target's roof (director 2026-10-26 "High arc, lands on roof"; supersedes reader bar L5 for the sim path, LeapArc): its top clears every building the body passes over by clear (design units at body scale 1), the path sampled every landing_step units, the top raised by clear up to arc_tries times; through the settle the body sinks from the roof to the street as the building breaks under it. On contact one blow of damage hits at full force within ring (x body scale) and fades to nothing at twice it (shockwave), through the carve path; tanks in it slide outward by fling x the force. cooldown from the press. shoulder = the highest roof a leap lands on, as a share of the body's drawn height (kaiju_height x body scale): the shoulder joint (arm_l0's head) over the model's height in assets/kaiju/reptilian_<stage>.rig.json, 123.38/200, 186.48/260, 208.77/320 (D-361 "Tall ones: hit the side"); a taller target takes the leap in its side: the arc ends at its facade, the body carves into it in flight (the body sweep, D-268) and the feet land on the street at its foot (backed off in landing_step units until outside it), where the smash and ring hit it; one that dwarfs the body keeps the D-091 rule above. PLACEHOLDER NUMBERS (tune) except the phase times and shoulder.

reptilian._turn: D-302 ('a cycle of ~2.7 s (a step ~1.35 s, stride ~15 m)'): the Colossus steps its turns at its own, slower rates, so a 90 deg turn spans at least one full step (smoke 1.55-1.9 s, with D-187's stepped U-turn: uturn_s, turn_steps, turn_slow); was the shared 1.62 and 2.7. turn_slow_pow 0.5: its long step (5.71) swings the body about a foot further back, so its stride stays down until the U-turn's spin eases (gait no-lunge <= 1.9x: 2.00 at 1, 2026-10-28). pivot = the clip's front planted toe tip (ahead, across), re-measured 2026-10-27 (D-201); was [4.2, 3.2].

bolt._note: BoltRig/BoltView/bolt.gdshader (VFX_STYLE family 6, research 17): the Lightning Breath and the Thunder Beam. halo_mode picks the fringe colours round the white-hot axis (R 17.6 is the director's open question: amber / eye = the species' eye tint / violet = white with a violet fringe); the glow itself is the engine's bloom on the HDR axis (boost_core, fringe_boost). The Thunder Beam core is 1.8x the breath's. Strokes come at least stroke_gap apart (never more than 3 full flashes a second); between strokes the main channel holds at hold_level with a shallow wobble. All shapes are dimensionless (a share of the bolt's length) and seeded per breath (Seeds breath_bolt / thunder_bolt). Widths are metres at body scale 1. D-357: purple is the kaiju colour (the kaiju juice): halo_mode purple, core = the axis colour, flare = the mouth light and flares; the bolt leaves from deep in the throat (throat = [share along both jaws from the hinge, share of the way from the lower jaw to the upper]), straight to what it strikes (bow 0, clear 0); charge = the charge-up arcs jumping spine to spine along the ridge (bones, tail tip to head) between the press and the strike: hop_life s each, the first after lead_in, the last ending at the strike, re-rolled every `every` s; the jaw drops jaw_before s before the strike. Widths are metres at body scale 1, lift in voxels.

street._doc: People run once the kaiju is within panic_per_scale x body scale m (at most panic_radius, an adult's), after panic_gawk s staring at it; they calm past calm_radius in the same proportion. A stomp crushes within its radius plus stomp_catch x body scale; a falling section reaches fall_spill m past its strip or walls, and people under it at its start freeze there (nobody outruns a falling tower).

tank_beacon._note: A flashing amber beacon on every tank's turret roof whenever the street lamps are lit (director 2026-10-30: tanks cannot be seen at night): an emissive ball (bloom does the glow), size radius, energy emission strength, on for `on` of every `period` seconds, each tank on its own beat. Placeholders for the director.

heli_lights._note: Night flying lights on every gunship (D-183; one look across helicopters): red on the left and green on the right at wing height (wing = how far out, of half the hull's width), a white strobe on the tail (flash strobe_on of every strobe_period seconds, each helicopter on its own beat), a faint pale belly lamp so the underside reads, and self_light = every cell glows faintly in its own colour so the dark hull does not vanish against the night city; energies are the emission strength the bloom turns into glow; mast = lamp height in the hull's box. Placeholders for the critic.

destruction._ruin_shadows: D-408 (off). 1: rubble heaps, strips and thrown chunks (RuinYard) cast shadows; 0: they do not (2,518 casters at bulldozer frame 2600, docs/research/2026-10-31-cpu-profile.md).
destruction._fall_dirs: b2-5 (D-387): the odds a toppling part (not a landmark's) falls toward its cut side (the side the support rule tips it, or the kaiju's for a base eaten whole), to each side of that, or away from it; cut + 2 x side + away = 1. Drawn from the run's seed, one draw per topple.
destruction._carve_view: Destruction plan stage 1 (D-327): a carved building is drawn from its own fine cells in play (CityCarve), so a blow bites out exactly what the sim removed and a falling section is exactly its cells. view_upload_usec: main-thread microseconds a frame all fine-grid views together may spend making meshes of finished arrays.

lights._note: Positional lights (street lamps, fires, police beacons; R 12.1, R 12.2). Only the pool_size lights nearest the camera are real lights (gl_compatibility ignores every positional light past 32 a frame, rendering/limits/opengl/max_renderable_lights); the rest are their emissive voxels and glow. Each light also fades out with camera distance: begin and length in metres.

rain._note: Rain (WeatherView, VFX family 11, D-155 / director 2026-10-23 'Heavy, kaiju clear'). Streaks are screen-facing quads at one screen angle (the fall direction as the camera sees it), in three depth layers, each its own world-space volume that follows the camera; counts are x the graphics preset's particles ratio. len and width are shares of the viewport height (so a streak is as long and as thick on a 1080p and a 4K screen), speeds m/s, alphas 0..1, shares of life. Colours are the fog grey lifted toward white, never above max_channel (under the 0.9 bloom threshold). min_streak_share and min_streak_alpha are the floors the weather suite holds the look above (a rain you can see).

render_opt._note: Render plan 2026-10-26. night_clip_max: the most of a night still that may sit at 0-2 of 255 (item 4; tests/lib/night_clip.gd). remesh_high_priority: a carved building's meshing task (CellView) is queued high-priority, as Jolt's jobs are (item 9). remesh_worker_mesh: under a real renderer each carved block's mesh is made and uploaded on its worker, so the swap-in only attaches them, every block of a batch on one frame (item 9c; off, or headless: made on the main thread). native_colliders: a carved building's static colliders (CarveCollider) take their boxes from the native core (KaijuCarve.region_boxes) and keep one body per region, its shapes swapped through the physics server (item 10); a building's first build is spread over physics ticks, collider_boxes_per_tick boxes a tick (about 1 ms). island_merged: a falling island (IslandBody) draws as one merged mesh and one patch (IslandMesh), a dropped brick hidden in place, remeshed on a worker after each break, its boxes added straight to its body (item 11). facade_aa (window-flicker, director 10-27 "flashing/stuttering lit windows"): the stand-in and skyline facades box-filter their window pattern over the pixel (every facade cell under it, weighted by the share it covers, the footprint held to facade_aa_cells cells each way) once a pixel spans more than facade_aa_start cells, so windows thinner than a pixel stop popping in motion; nearer walls keep the one exact sample. Look flags live in data/looks.json: deband, agx_contrast, post_contrast.

death._note: The kaiju's death (director 2026-10-26, every kaiju; replaces D-267's belly-down slump): Special K overload. A death (reasons, SaveFile.DEATHS) plays the agonised stagger clip for stagger_s (clip death_stagger, frames 20-60 of the approved stagger at 24 fps), the stone creeps over him for stone_s, then he shatters (DeathOverload): shards of his own body (cell world units each at body scale 1, picked from his body discs) are thrown throw_min..throw_max (x body scale) and land after flight_s, each a blow of shard_damage within shard_radius on the top shard_floors floors of what it lands on. A Death Blast node (stat death_blast, 1 per node) adds a front of blast_damage that runs out to a ring round his body: his body's edge plus death_blast x per_node world units (director 2026-10-26 "Smaller: a ring round his body"; 5 / 10 / 15, node 3 about one street block), in blast_s, every floor, and it starts blast_after_s after the last shard lands (director 2026-10-27, D-294 "Shards first": his falling stone body smashes buildings, then the blast clears the rest). The run ends settle_s after the front (or the last shard with no node). Look: violet = Special K (creation.lab.colors.special_k); stone grey with per-block variation. He breaks into jagged stone chunks, never cubes (director 2026-10-27, D-323 "Jagged stone chunks": irregular broken rock in his hide's texture, many sizes, tumbling with dust): look.chunks are the broken rock meshes baked by tools/blender/death_chunks.py (longest side 1); his voxels fly as small chunks of debris_size x his voxel and the sim's shards as big ones of shard_size x cell (most near the small end, size_skew), tumbling at debris_spin rad/s, each shard trailing dust (trail). Placeholders, flagged for tuning.

airstrike._note: Time's up (D-263, director 2026-10-31 "Jet run", FinalStrike): jets jets fly one run_length run across the screen through him in pass_s at altitude, dropping bombs bombs evenly over bomb_span centred on him, each landing fall_s after the lead jet passes its point: damage within radius on the bottom floors floors. His death starts death_after_s after the last bomb. Placeholders, flagged for tuning.

boats._note: D-404 boats (BoatView): the Tripo harbour mix voxelised by tools/boats/bake.sh at real size (voxel sim units a cell, the street props' cube; metres_tall each, a sim unit is metres_per_unit m); draft: share of the height under water. Moored at the piers (pier_spacing a slot, pier_fill of slots taken, pier_gap off the deck), bay of them at anchor in the bay, river of them on the river (river_bank: share of its half-width off the middle). Each rocks rock_deg at rock_hz and bobs bob; the kaiju within wake_radius rocks it up to wake_rock_deg more and pushes it away at flee_push (units/s^2, drag a second), its wake fading over wake_fade_s; within capsize_radius it rolls over in capsize_s and sinks over sink_s.

wildlife._note: Sky and sea life (WildlifeView; director comments 63, 66, 71; DESIGN atmosphere): spectacle only. Gulls: flocks x per_flock circling (radius m, speed rad/s, height m over the sea) round centres at area_x and the coast + area_z. Pigeons: flocks x per_flock on roofs at least min_height tall; scattered, they wheel (radius, speed) wheel_lift over their roof. A roar (leap, ultimate, ability) scatters every bird within roar_radius of the kaiju, a section landing those within fall_radius: flee_speed and flee_up m/s for flee_seconds, then gulls settle back at settle per second. span: wingtip to wingtip m; flap_rate rad/s; flap_lift: tip lift share. Whale: surfacings per run, the first after first s, then gap s apart; rises from depth m under the sea over rise_seconds, spouts, swims at swim m/s for stay s, dives over dive_seconds, and dives at once on a roar; length, width, hump m.
